ns2:course.label: Graduate Foundation Studio
ns2:course.description: Graduate-level introduction, for students without a BLA, to the fundamentals of design, including studies in two- and three-dimensional abstract and applied problems, basic elements and procedures of design, and principles of landscape composition. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. No undergraduate credit. 5 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to Landscape Architecture Graduate Students.
